title: Manifest of the frozen forecast ledger (r3-P39 / r4-P22)
public_safe: Counts of rows only; the creator count is printed under the nested-count rule. No creator, channel, id, title or quotation. The ledger itself stays private.
status: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Model-coded candidates (LAB-F, TL-BUILD) with rule-based fields, not checked by a person.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
gates: The forecast class (F1, world-future statement, against the rest) fell below its reliability floor on the hold-out reliability sample (gate D, kappa 0.507, 90% interval 0.169 to 0.792, against 0.60), and the checkability parts failed their two-model gate and are kept as the record by the owner's decision (registry 00:30); the ledger therefore lists model-coded candidates (LAB-F; GATES), not forecasts established by a person.
creator_count: all but fewer than 5 of the 71 seen creators
scope: Every kept, coded world-future statement candidate (F1) of the seen creators in TL-BUILD's rows: the dated ones (a bounded, model-coded time expression) and, as their frozen comparison set, the undated ones (needed by r4-P23's bounded share and by r3-P72's matched undated statements).

field_notes.resolvability: rule-based class R / NE / NU / M, plus NX (residual: bounded, not energetic, no observable public predicate or nothing specific enough), with every component kept
field_notes.flags: C (conditional: rule-based, or LAB-F's model-coded CL/CE; collective-choice part rule-based) and D (date refusal, rule-based)
field_notes.deixis: rule-based form and function relative to the upload date (ling), beside the model-coded FE kinds
field_notes.qualifiers: rule-based families (emic: time-hedge, probability doctrine, collective-choice conditional, outcome-booster, energetic predicate, prevention or obstruction), beside LAB-F's model-coded hedge, booster and condition
field_notes.contact: rule-based contact class (et's five contact strata) against world event, beside the model-coded scope
field_notes.recognizer: per date token: seam distance, word probability and its difference from the recording's and the creator's function-word median, distance to a filter removal; grid agreement not stored
field_notes.placebo: llm's window-shifted placebo draw (seeded), shifted windows at minus and plus 12 months
field_notes.instrument: labeller models, variants and label freeze time; checkability record and second reading with their agreement; the checkability parts inherit a failed gate

coder_wording: rule-based, not checked by a person
not_stored: grid agreement of date tokens (no token-level second decode is stored)
the forecast class's two-model flag per statement (not stored in the label files)
llm's constructed-item grammars (not written in step 0)
